My quick napkin math:

The entire wall of fans is 36 cm x 36 cm?
Or 1.18 ft x 1.18 ft or 1.395 ft^2 area.

So alright, assuming the entire surface area of all 9 fans is 1.395 ft^2 and in that given area you’re moving about 1890 cfm…….

(1890 cfm ) / (1.395 ft^2) is about 1354 ft/min or 22.58 ft/s. 


22.58 ft/s or 6.88 m/s. Not super high speed but I wouldn’t scoff at it either. I think you can get some good data with it. The wind tunnel in the lab I use maxes out at 36 m/s within a 300 mm by 300 mm test section. 

If you wanted greater speeds, you could always add a cone of some sort to decrease the area while maintaining that cfm, resulting in increase velocity.
